verdict.rationale: LlamaParse documents support for 130+ file formats. Parsing goes through a single format-agnostic call (client.parsing.parse with a file_id) under one API key and SDK, and there is explicit coverage of PDFs, scans, images and Excel spreadsheets. That clearly delivers the core 'one API, no per-format plumbing' story. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of DOCX, PPTX, HTML and email (EML/MSG) support (the format list is only summarized as '130+ across four categories'), and no independent or hands-on confirmation of mixed-format handling.
